patch.title: Under the Flyover
patch.logline: Beneath a Hyderabad flyover, a boy squats on a strip of soil, absorbed in a phone, while the traffic turns around him.
patch.treatment: Traffic swings through a U-turn beneath a concrete flyover. On a raised planting bed of bare soil in the median, a few bags, plastic covers and cooking utensils mark where someone stays; there is no tent. A boy squats on the soil in dirty, torn clothes, bent over a smartphone, scrolling short videos. The film watches without explaining: the engines and horns of the turning traffic, the thin sound of the reels, the small movement of his thumb. We don't learn who he is or how he came to be here. The last shot stays close on his absorbed face as vehicles keep turning behind him, and leaves the contrast to the audience.
observed: A homeless child squatting beneath a flyover in Hyderabad.
The child wore dirty, torn clothes.
He was deeply absorbed in scrolling reels on a smartphone.
The place was at a U-turn, on a raised planting bed containing soil.
A few bags, covers and basic cooking utensils were there; not a tent.
The observer found the contrast disturbing (the film's starting point; not shown on screen).
creative_additions: The boy is fictional: his age (about 10), build, hair and clothing colours are invented.
Late-afternoon daylight in the flyover's shade.
Sound design: turning traffic, engines, occasional horns, the phone's thin reel audio; no music.
Camera: a static wide, a slow push-in, a static close-up; shot order and durations.
Gestures: elbows on knees, thumb flicking up the screen.
The phone's colours flickering faintly on his face in the shade; screen content never readable.
The specific utensils (a blackened pot, a pan, steel plates) and plastic covers.
guardrails: Fictional child; not based on, and not resembling, any identifiable real child.
No backstory: nothing about who he is, why he is there, or where his family is.
No causal claim: the film doesn't suggest the phone or scrolling caused his poverty, or the reverse.
Dignity: no staged squalor beyond what was observed, no exaggerated dirt or distress, no begging or pleading to camera.
No real apps, brands, logos, creators or readable text on the phone or in the surroundings.
Observational: no slow motion and no music telling the audience what to feel.

assets.name: Boy (fictional)
assets.description: Fictional Indian boy about 10, thin, short untidy black hair, barefoot, faded torn dusty T-shirt and shorts.
assets.image_prompt: Full-body character reference photo of a fictional Indian boy about 10 years old, thin build, short untidy black hair, barefoot, wearing a faded, torn and dusty grey T-shirt and dark blue shorts. Standing straight and facing the camera, arms relaxed, calm neutral expression. Plain mid-grey studio background, soft even light, photorealistic, natural skin texture, sharp focus. assets.name: Flyover U-turn
assets.description: Beneath a concrete flyover at a U-turn: raised median planting bed of bare soil with a few bags, plastic covers and basic cooking utensils; no tent.
assets.image_prompt: Eye-level wide photograph beneath a concrete city flyover in Hyderabad, India, at a U-turn: a raised median planting bed of bare brown soil with a few cloth bags, folded plastic covers and basic cooking utensils (a blackened aluminium pot, a pan, steel plates) on it; no tent; no pedestrians; auto-rickshaws, motorbikes and cars turning around the median in the background, motion-blurred; late-afternoon daylight in the flyover's shade; dusty, stained concrete pillars. Photorealistic, natural colour, no readable signs, no logos, no text. 16:9.

assets.name: Phone

shots.title: The U-turn
shots.intention: Establish the place, and how small he is in it.
shots.action: Vehicles swing through the U-turn beneath the flyover. On the raised planting bed of soil in the median, a few bags, plastic covers and cooking utensils sit near @boy, who squats with his head bent over a phone.
shots.audio: Traffic turning and passing under the flyover, engines, an occasional horn; no music.

shots.title: Absorbed
shots.intention: His absorption, set against the moving city.
shots.action: @boy squats on the soil, elbows on knees, thumb flicking up the phone screen; vehicles pass behind him, softly out of focus.
shots.audio: Traffic, slightly softer; the phone's thin reel audio becomes audible; no music.

shots.title: The screen
shots.intention: Stay with him; leave the contrast to the audience.
shots.action: Close on @boy's absorbed face, the phone's colours flickering faintly on his skin; he keeps scrolling as vehicles pass, out of focus, behind him.
shots.audio: The phone's reel audio, close and thin, over the traffic; a distant horn; no music.
